about_blocks.text: Provides team-based outpatient treatment addressing addiction, family violence, child care, Aboriginal justice, and youth issues. Uses a 12-step approach focused on honesty, sobriety, and goal-setting. Services include individual, family, and group counselling, life skills training, referral access to child care and transportation for clients, counselling for those affected by another person’s substance misuse. Also provides a circle of healing program that is based on traditional healing, emphasizing family values. Prevention activities include workshops about alcohol and drugs, as well as suicide prevention, and men and violence. Serves anyone in the community.
